description: Audit a Prometheus rule file. Reports an alert with no for clause, which fires on a single evaluation so one scrape failure is a page; a duplicate alert name, which notifications and silences cannot distinguish; a missing routing label or runbook annotation; a rate applied to a gauge, where the result is a number with no meaning rather than a wrong one; and a reference to a metric that is not in a supplied list, where the rule never fires so it looks like coverage and is none. Pay 170000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

max_for_minutes.description: The longest an alert may wait before firing.

known_metrics.description: The metrics that exist, with their types. Omitting it is reported as not having checked expressions against one, so a rule over a nonexistent metric was not detected.

rules.description: A Prometheus rule file as YAML, with a groups array. Nothing is fetched: no backend is queried and no credential is accepted, so the data supplied is the whole input.
rules.example:
groups:
  - name: api
    rules:
      - alert: HighErrorRate
        expr: rate(http_requests_total[5m]) > 10
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: errors are high
      - alert: QueueBacklog
        expr: rate(queue_depth[5m]) > 100
        labels:
          team: platform
  - name: api-extra
    rules:
      - alert: HighErrorRate
        expr: absent(service_up)
        for: 2h
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: service is gone

name: alert_rule_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

conformant.description: True only when every rule was examined and every check that ran found nothing.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Alert Rule Audit
